reason: The winch at the buried pallet seems like a direct way to pull the array free.
expectation: I expect to attach or use the winch to lift the pallet, though it may need an anchor first.

alternatives.reason: The frame might provide an anchor, but I want to try the winch at the pallet first.

effect: The array is free and the next task is to power the cabin.
reaction: That was quicker than I expected; I am curious how the frame helps with power.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and the frame may hold a useful part.
expectation: I expect to dismantle or modify the shipping frame, though I don't know what it will yield.

effect: The frame became reusable aluminium stock, so I can make something from it.
reaction: Salvaging the shipping braces feels practical and satisfying.
reason: The only offered combination uses the tool on the stock, presumably to make a component for the array.
expectation: I expect to fabricate a support or fitting, but the exact part is unclear.

effect: The cut stock can make mounting feet for the recovered array, connecting the salvage to the power goal.
reaction: The specific use makes the fabrication clearer, though cutting alone was a small intermediate step.
reason: The only combination attaches the cut stock to the array, apparently to mount it.
expectation: I expect a supported array ready to connect to the cabin.

effect: The array now stands on its mounting feet, ready for its lead.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the recovered material become a usable support.
reason: The power lead is the natural next connection and the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the lead to connect the array to the cabin, supplying power.

effect: The array now powers the cabin and both goals are complete.
reaction: The fan returning to its ordinary note gives the repair a tangible, pleasing consequence.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making mounting feet from the shipping frame and then hearing the cabin fan settle made the salvage feel useful and connected to survival.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cutting the aluminium was a brief intermediate step with only one possible action; its purpose became clear afterward, but the action itself involved little decision.

surprise.text: I expected the winch might first need an anchor, but it recovered the array immediately.

arbitrary.text: The tool and frame pairing initially lacked a clear purpose beyond the compatibility hint, though the resulting reusable stock explained it.

continue.text: Yes, I would try another chapter: repurposing the frame and seeing the cabin respond made me curious about building the rest of the expedition, though I hope for more choices.
